## Current focus

0.1.0 shipped specification milestones M0 + M1: framework plus one adapter per integration (A01 Scribe's Table glyph
crafting, I01 Scroll Forge, N01/N02 Glyph Press). No registered content of its own: it adds performances to other
mods' stations, so the inventory above is empty by design.

## Roadmap

- [ ] M2: remaining Scribe operations (A02 every `IScribeable`), Imbuement, all Apparatus recipe families, Alteration,
  all seven Arcane Anvil branches, Inscription Table, Alchemist Cauldron (brewing, recycling with native RNG once).
- [ ] M3: Spell Loom (export, conversion, school), ANS carrier binding, all five ANS rituals, every native ritual
  profile (`NATIVE_ONGOING_EFFECT` adapters).
- [ ] M4: Source networks, helpers, potion network, storage links, scrying, portals, JEI/Jade, per-registry triage.
- [ ] M5: in-game guide, translations, dedicated-server multiplayer and latency playtests, release report.

## Decisions

See `docs/architecture.md` (D-01..D-12). Short form: native code always performs the operation once; nothing is ever
charged, refunded or bonused by a performance; the grade is display-only; automation (fake players) is never gated;
mixins into mod classes use `remap = false` with dev and SRG names; integration versions are checked at runtime.

## Known issues

- Iron's Scroll Forge exposes all four slots to hoppers natively (including the preview in slot 3). Not wrapped; any
  slot change releases a session before anything moves.
- Scribe's Table: the inscription starts from an empty-handed right-click with nothing on the table; with a book on
  the table the first click takes the book (native), the second begins the inscription.
